system: You read IBM 3270 green-screen operator consoles. Reply with exactly the JSON the schema asks for: one entry per text element visible on screen. Positions are 1-indexed: row 1 is the top line, column 1 is the leftmost column. kinds: title, screen-id, heading, datetime, label, value, input, message, status, footer, pfkey.
user_text: List every text element on this 80x24 green screen: titles, headings, labels, values, input fields, messages, the status line and function-key hints. For each give its exact text, 1-indexed row and column, kind, and whether the field is protected (true) or an editable input (false).
